+=== camel-weather - the CamelWeatherQuery header has the appid masked
+The `CamelWeatherQuery` header that the consumer and the producer set has the value of the `APPID` query parameter
+masked as `xxxxxx`, and so do the log and the error messages that show the request URL. The request to OpenWeatherMap
+still sends the real `appid`. A route that read the API key from this header must use the `appid` option instead.
